summary: Desktop loading states the user picked from an HTML mock: a chat that is loading shows shimmering skeleton messages, anchored to the bottom by the composer and filling the pane on any screen size (row count from the screen height); a provider or profile switch closes the picker popup and shows a spinner in place of the avatar on the picker button, with 'Switching to <name>... You can keep typing.' in the composer and a hidden live region for screen readers; Extend on a session link shows a spinner, then 'Extended' and an accent flash on the link text.

reactNativeIos.reason: The phone already shows its own load and switch states (#241); this change is the desktop's visual treatment only.
